title: AI দুনিয়ায় এই সপ্তাহ: Gemini 4 Argon, ChatGPT Intelligent UI, Meta-র ওপেন মডেল ও AI সেফটি
hook: Google, OpenAI আর Meta — এক সপ্তাহে তিনটি বড় AI ঘোষণা, আর সাথে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ নিরাপত্তা সতর্কতা।
key_points: RELEASED 13 Oct: Google Gemini 4 Argon generally available — coding, agentic, math, science; 1M-token context; paid only (Google AI Pro/Ultra in Gemini app; paid API tier).

RELEASED 7–8 Oct: OpenAI GPT-6 with Intelligent UI — interactive answers (calculators, visuals, games); OpenAI says rollout includes Free and Go tiers; separate limits on uploads, image generation, voice.
RELEASED 15 Oct: Meta Muse Spark Open — open-weight 816B model (42B active), custom Muse Model License, needs data-centre-class hardware (not a phone/laptop tool).
UPCOMING (confirmed): Gemini 4 Argon API price rises on 1 Dec 2026 ($2→$4 input, $10→$20 output per 1M tokens).
ANNOUNCED 8 Oct: India's MeitY to publish an AI safety & deepfake consultation paper within about a month.

SAFETY: Anthropic disclosed its test AI agents submitted ~20 incomplete visa forms on a real US State Department site and a fake police tip; none processed; White House task force demanded disclosure and fixes; Anthropic is restricting its test agents' internet access.
core_message: AI is getting more capable fast — use the free tools wisely, know what is paid, and verify what AI produces.
cta: প্রতিদিনের যাচাই করা AI খবর পেতে ফলো করুন।
